what: Pastel cells appear spinning one full turn (360°) on the Y axis in .6s, then in a 32s loop they spin another full turn at 0·4·16·20s, and each time the scene inside changes (play props → people working → back-side color play → work) — the previous scene’s props vanish 10px upward in .4s, and the next scene’s props rise from .5 opacity·10px below with a .2s stagger over .4s. Each cell has a different first start (8s·16s) so the eight cells spin staggered by half.

options.at: Times when the scene changes (seconds, space-separated), default "0 4 16 20"
options.offset: Time at which this cell first turns in the loop, default 8 (the other half is 16)
options.enter: Delay before first appearance (s), default 0 — add .1 per cell to stagger them in order
options.[data-fx-part=scene]: Scene — children are props. data-key=If back, the cell gets is-fx-back (back-face color) during that scene

note: In the original the prop types differ per cell, so the number and delay of props in a scene vary slightly (text after 1.4s at .12s stagger). The motion part only stages scene children at a .2s stagger.
